35 Years Later, Charge Sheet Filed in Sarla Bhatt Murder Case

Authorities have filed a 737-page charge sheet 35 years after the 1990 abduction, torture, and murder of Sarla Bhatt, a Kashmiri Pandit nurse. Yasin Malik has been named as a primary accused in the case, alongside four others. The charge sheet details the events of her abduction and subsequent killing, with the investigation agency citing new evidence and witnesses.
